title: Chipped front tooth after a basketball elbow

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: I took an elbow playing basketball. The Lakers fan in me is crying.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Number nine has a chip on the incisal edge, enamel and a little dentin, no pulp exposure.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Bonding the incisal edge on nine with composite today.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Let's check the nerve on nine again in six weeks since it took a hit.
